displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is P and digit 1 is 0. The code is P0
meaning: Compressor protector open. The compressor is off.
causes: No current through the run or start windings
Compressor not wired to the control, or other faulty compressor wiring
Failed run capacitor or faulty run-capacitor wiring
diySteps: Write down P0 before power is cycled. The chart says the fault can clear after 1 normal cycle or by cycling 24 VAC to the control, after the cause is corrected
Technician: check the compressor, the wiring, and the run capacitor
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. An open compressor protector is not cleared by rinsing the outdoor coil.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
sourceTitle: Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27, PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic codes (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC, ASZC, DSZC, GSZC). Read 2026-11-07
